en:
Kaede, Shuichi! I would like to ask you two
a question!

You were on lookout inside this classroom,
right?

Yeah. From here, we could keep an eye on the
basement, and it was close to the library, too.
That's our alibi.

We were both in this classroom when the
murder occurred.

I see... Then the probability that you two
committed the crime is extremely low...

By the way...were you two together the
entire time?

No...I did leave for a bit to see what was
happening in the basement.

But besides that, we were together the
whole time, until the receiver went off.
Y-Yeah, that's right...
...I understand. Thank you very much.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Lookout Classroom<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
Is that all you wanted to ask?

Oh, may I ask you one more question?
Specifically, about that vent...
It appears to be connected to this classroom.

The air duct in the basement hallway leads
to it...

Yes, I was also concerned about this vent...
That's why we kept watch in this classroom.

Because the culprit wouldn't be able to use
this vent if we're in here on lookout.

Under those circumstances, it would be
difficult to sneak into the library from here.

Kaede stacked up books in front
of the library vent as well.

With those in the way, it would be even
harder for someone to go in and out.

Really? I will be sure to save that important
piece of information to my memory bank.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Classroom Vent<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

I hope my line of questioning has not offended
either of you.

It is necessary, so that we may find the
truth.

Keebo, you totally sounded like a detective
or a lawyer just now!

Oh! Maybe you were a detective or a lawyer
in a past life!

A past life...? How could I have a past life
when I'm not made of human components?

Let's ask these two what they were doing
when the body discovery announcement played.
Have you already spoken to Tsumugi?

She's at the crime scene in the library,
right?

Kehehe... Let me guess.
You wish to hear my alibi, yes?
Huh? How'd you know?

My appearance and actions thus far suggest 
I am someone who would commit a murder.
<CLT=cltMIND>At least he's self-aware...
So, to briefly state the truth...

When the body discovery announcement
played, I was in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>dining hall<CLT=cltNORMAL>, eating supper.

The other people there with me 
were Miu, Kirumi, and Tsumugi.

The Monokubs prepared the meal for me.
It was listed on the menu as...

<CLT=cltSTRONG>"Pasta that tastes like a lonely old lady eating
her grandkid's birthday cake"<CLT=cltNORMAL> or somesuch...
...That pasta sounds depressing.

That concludes my alibi...
I do hope it can be of some help.

And what about the people around you?
Did you notice anything in particular?

Ah...if there was something to note, it would be
that Miu was tinkering with something or other.

There was also a brief period of time where
Tsumugi left to use the restroom.
The restroom, huh? Interesting.
Well, Tsumugi *is* the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Cosplayer<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

She could've gone to the bathroom to
secretly disguise herself as someone else.
Someone else? But who?

I don't know, but I'll go talk to her. She should
be at the crime scene in the library.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Korekiyo's Account<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad."

When the body discovery announcement
played, I was in the dining hall, eating supper.

The other people there with me 
were Miu, Kirumi, and Tsumugi.

Tsumugi left to use the restroom at some 
point. However, she wasn't gone long.

<CLT=cltMIND>That bothers me... Tsumugi *is* the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Cosplayer<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>She could've gone to the bathroom to
secretly disguise herself as someone else.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm not sure who, though... Anyway, I'll talk to
her. She should be in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>But before that, I still need to confirm
Keebo's alibi...

Hey, Keebo, what were you doing and where
during the body discovery announcement?
Ah... My alibi.
...Um, are you glitching right now?
No, I'm just searching for the right words.

In all honesty, I was alone in my room, so I
admit my alibi is not altogether reliable...
So...you don't have an alibi?

But Ryoma said he was alone in his room,
too.
Geez, way to throw him under the bus.
Huh!? Th-That was not my intention!

<CLT=cltMIND>But I see... Both Keebo and Ryoma
don't have an alibi...

<CLT=cltMIND>That means, it's possible one of those two
is the mastermind...

Umm... Am I under suspicion because I don't
have an alibi?

No... I won't suspect you just because you
don't have an alibi.

And I'm not saying that because you're a
robot or anything! I'm not robophobic at all!

Thank you very much.
But...you don't need to be so PC.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>K1-B0's Account<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

I was alone in my room, so I admit my alibi
is not altogether reliable...

No... I won't suspect you just because you
don't have an alibi.

And I'm not saying that because you're a
robot or anything! I'm not robophobic at all!
S-Sure, but...you don't need to be so PC.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't leave yet...
There's still something I need to check.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>What a weird blackboard...
But it's not related to this case.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's wrapped with barbed wire...
This isn't related to this case.
<CLT=cltMIND>Teacher's Desk

<CLT=cltMIND>I'll ask those two what they were doing
during the body discovery announcement.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's the vent that connects to the library...

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi and I were on lookout in the
classroom that connects with this vent...

<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor currently displays a paused
countdown for the time limit...

<CLT=cltMIND>When the countdown stopped, all that obnoxious
noise stopped, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what would've happened if the
time limit had expired...

Putting aside the thing about Tsumugi...
Now we know everyone's alibi.
Huh? What about Kokichi?

We don't need to ask him.
He was definitely alone.

Everyone we talked to hadn't seen him, so
no one would corroborate his alibi, right?
That means he must have been alone.

Oh, you're right! I guess that's why you're
the detective and I'm...not!
